notes.title: More Visual Changes & Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Visual Improvements [/h1]
[olist]
[*] Each room has its own personalised atmosphere when you enter them
[*] Visual feedback added when trying  get a perk from a room 
[/olist]

[h1]General Polish[/h1]
[olist]
[*] UI Animations added for upgrades/perks collected 
[*] initial tutorial scene transition added
[*] Fog triggers  Added for rooms in tutorial
[*] Enemies in exploration phase are rebalanced
[*] Removed camera rotations for rooms that dont require them 
[/olist]

[h1]Fixes [/h1]
[olist]
[*] Player Dashing is no longer frame rate dependent, So now  dashing is more consistent when used 
[/olist]

Hope you like the updates we added :)

notes.title: Visual & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
1. softlock no longer happens when you go to the options menu, and then resume game 
2. Pixelation filter applied for entire game, it suits better with the voxel aesthetic 
3. visual bug related to normal maps fixed
4. improved lighting in certain areas
5. improved light path for the payload track 
6. Better Enemy Balancing in Payload section
